title: The actual completion unit on the normalized strict quotient cone
statement: Fix a prime l, finite E/Q_l, scheme Y, a coefficient derived-system calculus S, ordinary quotient model M and compatible derived model D. Let r be a normalized Roos model whose comparison is D.roos inverse. Let rho identify completion with the strict quotient cone on good flat-term K-flat complexes and satisfy TrfCompletionRoosNormalized. For each such P, the actual adjunction unit at Q(P) followed by rho_P equals Q of the constructed strict quotient cone augmentation. No boundedness or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Clause (2), pullback commutes with reductions, and clause (3), second paragraph: agent-formulated identification of the specified inverse-image comparison with the completion unit. Compare Stacks derived.tex Tag 08TC (definition-derived-limit) and the explicit cone map of def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison (b).

proof.text: Use the degreewise tensor M.quotient(P) as a simultaneous quotient presentation. The finite equations are D.reduction_evaluation; transition compatibility is M.transition. The normalization of rho yields a strict tower isomorphism a fixing these finite comparisons. Its section equation and the ordinary adjunction-unit tensor formula identify the first cone coordinate with the actual quotient-unit tuple. Both shifted coordinates vanish. The cone decomposition of the identity proves equality of whole chain maps. The existing actual-unit-at-complex formula, followed by rho, cancels the reduction comparison and restriction factors, while r=D.roos inverse cancels the Roos comparison. Localize the chain equality.

proof_origin.place: Clauses (2)–(3), explicit strict quotient augmentation and multiplication cancellation.

theorem strictQuotientCompletionUnit
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (Y : Scheme.{t})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E Y)
    (D : CompletionUnit.DerivedModel l E Y S M)
    (r : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E Y)
    (rho : integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E Y ⋙
          (S.reduction ⋙ coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y) ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y ⋙
          integralOperationsRoosFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hr : ∀ I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ,
      r.comparison.hom.app I = D.roos.inv.app I)
    (hrho : TrfCompletionRoosNormalized l E Y S r rho)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) :
    S.adjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫ rho.hom.app P =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (trfStrictQuotientConeAugmentation l E Y P.obj)
